The Chinese characters for Genevieve

As a transliteration, Genevieve is usually written 吉纳维芙 (Jí nà wéi fú). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Origin and meaning

From French, Genevieve carries the meaning “woman of the family”.

About the name Genevieve

Saint Genevieve is the patron saint of Paris.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “woman of the family”, a Genevieve calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
